data.narrative:
Blackstar is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Daniel Edrisian, former OpenAI Codex engineer and founder of Alex (YC W24), which was acqui-hired by OpenAI in September 2025. The company has raised $12M to date. The AI & Software sector comprises 1 public comparable (Palantir) and 8 private peers including Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI, though none provide sufficient overlap on stage, timing, or valuation tier for direct peer-median benchmarking.

Given data constraints, Stage-Progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method. Using total raised ($12M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A step-ups yields an implied value of $30M. This represents a reasonable post-seed mark given the founder's pedigree and prior company acquisition, though without comparable late-seed or early Series A transactions in the narrow peer set, validation is limited to methodology rather than market precedent.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $34M (median $30M). Key uncertainties include the absence of recent same-stage transactions among identified peers, preventing verification that the 2.5x multiplier accurately reflects current market conditions in frontier AI software. Revenue, ARR, or user metrics were not available to apply revenue multiple or SaaS benchmarking methods, further constraining the analysis. This valuation should be updated as the company approaches Series A with actual investor feedback and comparable round data.
